verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both fail the same way. The skates, the key image, are cropped down to an unreadable sliver at the top edge. The 'ICE RINK' headline is shrunk to a size close to the fine print, so the hierarchy is lost. The 'LINK IN BIO' button runs into the '50% OFF' text and the divider, and the arrow and circle decorations collide with the copy or are cut off. Most of the banner's width is empty while everything is crammed into the centre.
